comment_regular: Verified Oblivion TREE record dispatch: accepts TREE record type 0x1C, initializes the base form, and handles MODL/MODB, MODT, EDID, and DMTL (texture-hash cache) chunks. Unlike Fallout TESObjectTREE::Load/Save, this dispatcher has no SNAM seed-array or BNAM billboard-size case. The loader's complete switch and the Fallout routines establish this as a schema divergence; the source of Oblivion seed-array population outside this loader remains Unknown.
